scope: MBR.1 paired Full-KV fairness planning only; not Full-KV RTL, top selection, wrapper/macro/numeric selection, synthesis, PPA, or performance evidence.

anchors.mbr0_human_review_authorization: 2026-10-16 explicit user authorization; this MBR.1 planning-record commit was pending when the matrix was created

full_kv_candidate.definition: Future paired planning contour with common hot/R2/R1/S2 lifecycle and no Route-A sidecar or cross-source merge.
full_kv_candidate.authorization_limit: planning contour only; not Full-KV RTL or a synthesizable top

shared_configuration_requirements: same future selected technology/library/clock constraint if and only if a later implementation review selects one
same legal GQA cardinality and common S2 payload lifecycle
same common R1/R2 transaction identity and backpressure semantics
same declared external-memory service/profile basis; service is not zero cost
same workload/request definition for any later activity comparison

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Future Route-A integration shell is mixed common/differential; allocate its five categories once and prove every common subterm.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Future Full-KV integration shell is also mixed common/differential; common cancellation requires exact interface/topology/BOM equivalence.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: MBR.1 integration allocations; future top/BOM review
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Either future top's mux/state/interconnect is Route-A-only, free, or verification-only.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Retain common lifecycle control with only named packed delta separated.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Retain equivalent common lifecycle/terminal discipline.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: architecture contract; C4-D functional regression; future paired topology
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Whole R6 cost is Route-A incremental.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Packed authority/terminal branch is a Route-A activity delta.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No packed branch; do not synthesize a fake counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.4 accepted-event route and C0/C4 provenance
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Missing event means zero packed activity.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Pair common hot source open/release control.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Pair same hot source lifecycle control.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: architecture contract; hierarchy regression; future paired topology
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Common hot path may be charged wholesale to Route-A.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Route-A direct-pending transport/control increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No direct-pending counterpart within Full-KV contour.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3 direct-pending requirement; SRP.4 action map
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Route-A transport/control is free because data backing is external.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Pair common R2 arbitration; separately evidence Route-A activity delta.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Pair equivalent common request acceptance/backpressure control.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: R2 contract and future paired topology
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Similar arbiter names prove equal activity or area.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Pair R1 control ending at core_mem_if_v1.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Pair same R1 boundary and response/fault semantics.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: R1 wrapper contract; future physical wrapper mapping
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: External controller is inside either local control DUT.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Route-A typed source context must be separately mapped.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Common context may pair only after a concrete owner/type mapping.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C2 context regression; SRP.4 owner-carried action route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Private registry state supplies a count.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Typed packed/direct endpoint routing is a Route-A delta.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Full-KV uses only its named common delivery path.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C2 delivery regression; SRP.4 accepted carrier
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Endpoint demux activity can be inferred from fixture values.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Unique retained-member/publication control increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No R3 publication counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: B3 contract; SRP.3/SRP.4
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Publication control is common because it feeds common R6.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Post-R6 all-member activation, descriptor, and lease join.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No packed read activation counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C0/C1 contract; SRP.4 action map
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: No-early-read gating has no integration cost.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: M2 member/publish protocol and wrapper peripheral increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No M2 counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3 M2 requirements; SRP.4 M2 route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: A4 fixed proxy covers all dynamic M2 control.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Reference provider excluded from candidate DUT.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No Full-KV DUT counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: B3 regression only
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Functional reference becomes storage hardware.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Array-only proxy may be considered later; protocol/peripheral remains Route-A control.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No M2 array counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3 storage requirements; SRP.4 M2 action accounting
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Entire M2 item is covered by one A4 proxy.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: P3 fill, durable-write, sidecar association, and release control increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No P3 wrapper counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3 P3 requirements; C3/C4 regression
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Stage control is part of an external HBM black box.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Route-A pending backing uses declared external service.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Full-KV external complete-KV service remains separately nonzero on same declared basis.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3/SRP.4 external-memory plan; recovered A4.14.1
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Controller/PHY/CDC/calibration cost is zero.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Array-only stage proxy deferred; fill/release control remains inside.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No P3 stage counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3 P3 requirements; SRP.4 P3 route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Functional stage memory is a selected SRAM macro.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Page allocation, invalidation, generation, reclaim control increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No Route-A page allocator counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C3b/C4 regression; SRP.4 R5 route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Reclaim control cancels with common lifecycle.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Array-only availability proxy deferred; allocator/peripheral stays inside.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No R5 availability counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3 R5 requirements; SRP.4 R5 route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Availability state and its access are free.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Descriptor region/service is a Route-A external increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Full-KV external service remains nonzero but does not imply a descriptor region.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3/SRP.4 descriptor route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Descriptor maintenance is covered by payload accounting.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Pair S2 payload control and four-consumer legal-GQA lifecycle; sidecar excluded as increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Pair same payload/READY/four-consumer/release lifecycle without sidecar/cross-source merge.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: architecture S2 contract; C3a regression; future wrapper mapping
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Whole S2 is Route-A cost or an array-only black box.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Packed payload/terminal ingress and matching association control increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No packed ingress counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C2 contract; SRP.4 packed action route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Common S2 makes packed ingress common.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Sidecar array/proxy and endpoint/peripheral increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No position-sidecar counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: SRP.3 sidecar requirements; SRP.4 sidecar route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Sidecar has no dynamic access or wrapper cost.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Functional sidecar reference excluded from DUT.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No counterpart.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C2 regression only
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Reference adapter is a physical sidecar design.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Canonical packet/four-commit structural merge boundary increment.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No cross-source merge; common source service remains outside this row.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C3a contract; SRP.4 R4 structural route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Structural boundary proves numeric implementation.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Route-A numeric/partial differential remains external pending finite conformance/cost evidence.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: No cross-source numeric merge; source computation still external/nonzero.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: R4 numeric contract; SRP.3/SRP.4 numeric route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Functional R4 provider is a measured numeric kernel.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Source partial interface remains external; Route-A-specific action must be evidenced.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Common attention PE scope remains external and nonzero.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: partial-provider contract; SRP.4 activity route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: External PE cost cancels without a declared common profile.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Use declared external memory service/profile; Route-A traffic is separately recorded.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Use same declared service/profile; complete-KV traffic is separately recorded.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: R1 contract; SRP.3/SRP.4 external plan; recovered A4.14.1
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Service/profile or controller implementation is zero-cost.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Route-A drain/status delta needs real component status carriers.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Pair only a demonstrated common status function.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C3b/C4 provenance; SRP.4 accepted-event route
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Host-visible fixture status is DUT activity evidence.

comparison_rows.route_a_treatment: Excluded test-only evidence.
comparison_rows.full_kv_treatment: Excluded test-only evidence.
comparison_rows.evidence_route: C4-D regression only
comparison_rows.prohibited_assumption: Observer/oracle state belongs in either DUT.

integration_cost_allocations.required_evidence: future top port/BOM mapping and semantic regression
live owner connectivity and future top BOM
context schema/owner mapping and accepted-carrier route
physical-wrapper mapping and frozen semantic regression

non_additivity_rule: Payload and metadata service coordinates remain separate; this matrix cannot add them into latency, throughput, energy, or net-benefit results.
next_gate: human MBR.1 fairness review; no realization, implementation, synthesis, or PPA work is authorized
